lead.event: United States sets 18% tariff on Indonesian imports
lead.headline: US sets 18% tariff on Indonesian imports
lead.blurb: The United States announced the 18% rate on Indonesian goods as part of a new wave of import tariffs. Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said it is below the initial 25% threat and favorable compared with Singapore and Vietnam. Indonesia’s tariff schemes are 0%, 10% and 18% per commodity under an agreement signed in February, with excess capacity to be addressed through an addendum. The government can continue negotiations until 5 January 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: BRIS outlines its 2027 financing growth outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS projects double-digit financing growth in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: President Director Anggoro Eko Cahyo expects industry liquidity to remain tight through 2027, citing the government’s plan to withdraw excess budget balance funds and a BI rate expected to stay around 6%. He says prudent, selective financing will be key to keeping non-performing financing at safe levels.

earnings_guidance.headline: KKGI reports nine-month 2026 net profit of USD11.61 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Resource Alam Indonesia's revenue fell 2.55% to USD106.85 million year on year. Gross profit rose to USD31.42 million from USD17.39 million, while operating profit increased to USD21.28 million from USD2.92 million.
